info.title: Inventory Management
info.description: Maintaining up-to-date inventory for your items on Walmart.com ensures a better experience for your customers and greater sales opportunities for you.

get.description:
Retrieve the current inventory for a single SKU.

• If you do not add the `shipNode` query parameter, Walmart returns the quantity at your default ship node.
• Add `shipNode` to see stock at a specific fulfillment center.

Use this call to confirm stock before you accept or ship orders. The response shows the number of units available to sell (`amount`), the unit of measure (`EACH`), and the date the inventory becomes available if you set one.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description:
A unique alphanumeric ID you assign to each item. Use the same value in every request that references the item, including your XSD catalog file.

If the SKU contains any of the following characters, encode them:

": / ? # [ ] @ ! $ & ' ( ) * + , ; = { } %"

Encode spaces as "%20". You do not need to encode any other characters.

parameters.name: shipNode
parameters.description: The unique ID of the ship node (fulfillment center) whose inventory you want to retrieve. If you omit this parameter, the response includes inventory for every ship node linked to your seller account.

parameters.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.description: The access token retrieved in the Token API call

parameters.description: A unique ID which identifies each API call and used to track and debug issues; use a random generated GUID for this ID

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME

parameters.description:

post.description: Upload a feed file to update inventory for many SKUs in one request. Use `feedType=inventory` for single-node files (spec 1.4). Use `feedType=MP_INVENTORY` for multi-node files (spec 1.5, JSON only). Upload the file with `multipart/form-data` and the field name `file`. get.summary: Multiple item inventory for all ship nodes
get.description: Returns the inventory level for every SKU at every ship node. • Each response contains up to 50 records (zero- or non-zero inventory). • Use the `nextCursor` value from the last response to get the next page. Call the endpoint repeatedly, passing the updated `nextCursor` each time—until the response omits `nextCursor`. The WFS Inventory API provides real-time inventory data for items fulfilled through Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS). This API allows you to monitor stock availability, manage your catalog, item publishing, and lifecycle status. By querying for specific SKUs, you can access a wide range of inventory metrics, to ensure optimal stock management, streamline operations, and make informed decisions about WFS inventory. **Important:** Effective May 15, 2026, the API will begin enforcing sequential behavior and no longer support parallel requests. Any request that submits a cursor out of order, reuses a cursor from a prior response, or runs multiple requests simultaneously within the same session will receive a 404 error. The API endpoint, data format, and response structure are not changing, only the enforcement of the documented sequential requirement. **Do I need to take action?** If you manage inventory through an approved Solution Provider, they are responsible for confirming their integration meets this requirement. If you have questions about how this change may affect your inventory management, please contact your approved Solution Provider directly. If your integration already calls this API sequentially, one batch at a time before issuing the next request, then no changes are needed. If your integration makes parallel or concurrent calls using the same cursor token, you will need to update before May 15 to avoid errors. **Questions** Open a case through the Walmart Developer Support portal or contact your Partner Success Manager.

get.description: Returns Available-to-Sell quantities for your WFS items. Optional query parameters enable you to perform the following: • Filter by specific `sku` values. • Limit results to items updated after a given date. **Deprecation notice:** This endpoint will be removed in 2026 (more information to come). Switch to the WFS Inventory (new) API.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description:
The unique alphanumeric ID you assign to an item. Use the same value in every request that references the item, including your XSD catalog file.

If the SKU contains any of the following characters, encode them:

": / ? # [ ] @ ! $ & ' ( ) * + , ; = { } %"

Encode spaces as "%20". You do not need to encode any other characters.

parameters.name: fromModifiedDate
parameters.description: The start of the last modified date range. Returns only inventory records updated **on or after** this timestamp. Use 24-hour UTC format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` (for example, `2025-06-01 00:00:00`).

parameters.name: toModifiedDate
parameters.description: The end of the last-modified date range. Returns only inventory records updated **on or before** this timestamp. Use the same `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format as `fromModifiedDate`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of SKUs to include in the response (1–300). If you omit this parameter, Walmart returns up to 10 SKUs.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of SKUs to skip before Walmart starts listing results. Set to `0` to start at the first SKU.

parameters.name: shipNodeType
parameters.description:
Filter results by ship-node type.

- Only supported value is `multichannel`.
- Use this parameter only if you are a multi-channel seller.
- When you send `shipNodeType`, you must also send `sku`. All other query parameters are ignored.
- `sku` can be a single value or several SKUs separated by commas (for example, "sku1,sku2").

get.description:
The WFS Inventory API provides real-time inventory data for items fulfilled through Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS). This API allows you to monitor stock availability, manage your catalog, item publishing, and lifecycle status. By querying for specific SKUs, you can access a wide range of inventory metrics, to ensure optimal stock management, streamline operations, and make informed decisions about WFS inventory.

**Important:** This endpoint replaces the legacy WFS Inventory API (`/v3/fulfillment/inventory`), which will be deprecated in 2026 (more information to come). Switch to this new endpoint to continue accessing WFS inventory data.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: An arbitrary alphanumeric unique ID, specified by the seller, which identifies each item. This will be used by the seller in the XSD file to refer to each item. Special characters in the sku needing encoding are: ':', '/', '?', '#', '[', ']', '@', '!', '$', '&', "'", '(', ')', '*', '+', ',', ';', '=', ‘ ’ as well as '%' itself if it's a part of sku. Make sure to encode spaces with %20. Other characters don't need to be encoded.

parameters.name: gtin
parameters.description: Global Trade Item Number is a unique identifier for a product that is recognized internationally. This must be 14 digits.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of SKUs to be returned. Cannot be larger than 300.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset is the number of records you wish to skip before selecting records.

parameters.name: customerFavorite
parameters.description: Filters items by customer favorite status. When set to `true`, only customer favorites are returned. When set to `false`, only non-favorites are returned. If omitted, all items are returned.

parameters.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.description: Access token obtained from the Token API. This is required for authenticating requests to Walmart Marketplace APIs.

parameters.name: WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE
parameters.description: A unique ID to identify the consumer request by channel. Use the Consumer Channel Type received during onboarding.

parameters.name: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID
parameters.description: A unique ID that identifies each API call and is used to track and debug issues. Use a randomly generated GUID for this ID.

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the Walmart service being called.

totalCount.description: Total number of results for the query.

limit.description: Provides details on the current quantity of items available in inventory.

offset.description: Specifies the number of records to skip before selecting the results.

gtin.description: The Global Trade Identification Number (GTIN) associated with the item. If you provide a 12-digit UPC rather than a GTIN, the GTIN will start with two 0s followed by the UPC.

sku.description: The unique identifier assigned to the item by the seller.

itemID.description: The Walmart-assigned ID used to track items. This ID is located at the end of the item page URL.

offerID.description: The unique identifier assigned to a specific product offer. It is used to distinguish between different listings of the same product, which may vary by price, condition, or seller.

brand.description: Identifies the company or manufacturer that markets the item.

itemCondition.description: The item's condition described by its appearance, quality, packaging, functionality, and previous usage.

publishingStatus.description: WFS items' publishing status can be: Published, Unpublished, Processing, Stage, Error, or WFS Ineligible.

itemLifecycle.description:
• Active: The item is currently in your catalog, regardless of its publishing status.
  • Retired: The item has been removed from your catalog or has surpassed its listing end date. It can be reactivated.
  • Archived: The item has been permanently deleted from your catalog and cannot be reactivated.

stockStatus.description:
Out-of-stock items have 0 units available to sell.
At-risk items have fewer than 28 days of supply, including both available and inbound units.
In-stock items have more than 28 days of total supply.
Long term out of stock items that have been consistently out of stock for more than 30 days.
 New to WFS items that have been set up in WFS but haven't been inbounded because a shipment order has not been created.

availableUnits.description: Units available for customers to place orders for.

reservedUnits.description: The number of units from customer orders that have been placed but not yet fulfilled. Reserved units are not counted as available units, preventing overselling. Once these orders are shipped, the reserved units will decrease. If an order is canceled, the reserved units will become available again. Returns `0` when no units are currently reserved.

inboundUnits.description: The number of units that have been sent to WFS but have not yet been received.

inventoryReviewUnits.description: Units are undergoing a standard review process to check for compliance, expiration dates, cycle counts, and other validations. This process typically takes 24–48 hours.

inventoryMovementUnits.description: Units are being transferred to another WFS fulfillment center to improve item availability for more customers. This process typically takes 7–10 business days.

onhandUnits.description: The sum of available units, reserved units, and temporarily unavailable units due to inventory review and movement to other fulfillment centers.

inventoryAge.description: The breakdown of units across age buckets provides an overview of how long units have been stored in a WFS fulfillment center. For example, 365PlusDays indicates the number of units stored in a WFS fulfillment center for over 365 days.

firstInStockDate.description: The date when an item arrives for the first time at a WFS fulfillment center.

salesForecastWeek1to4.description: The number of units estimated to sell in the next 1-4 weeks, based on the item's forecasted sales demand.

salesForecastWeek5to8.description: The number of units estimated to sell in the next 5-8 weeks based on the item's forecasted sales demand.

salesForecastWeek9to12.description: The number of units estimated to sell in the next 9-12 weeks based on the item's forecasted sales demand.

sellThroughRate.description: The number of units shipped to customers in the last 90 days divided by the average number of units stored in a WFS fulfillment center during the same period.

daysOfSupply.description: The anticipated number of days your current available and inbound inventory will last, based on your daily forecasted sales demand.

outOfStockDate.description: The estimated date when the item will run out of stock, based on its days of supply.

suggestedUnits.description: The number of units recommended by Walmart to send to WFS based on the item's forecasted sales demand. These suggestions are generated by algorithms considering several factors including past sales, seasonality, listing, quality, pricing, and more.

surplusUnits.description: The number of units that exceed 180 days of supply, calculated based on the item's forecasted sales demand.

customerFavorite.description: Indicates whether the item is identified as a customer favorite based on customer demand.
